stem: The main difference between the Sweethearts and most other bands of the 1940s was that the Sweethearts —

options.label: A
options.text: were allowed to travel and perform in Europe

options.label: B
options.text: were a racially integrated group of women

options.label: C
options.text: played swing music outside the South

options.label: D
options.text: tended to perform in large cities
